mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.amount, e.expense_date, e.description, e.created_at, e.updated_at, c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name, pc.id AS parent_category_id, pc.name AS parent_category_name FROM expenses e JOIN categories c ON e.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN categories pc ON c.parent_id = pc.id WHERE e.id = #{id}
mapper.insert:
SELECT last_insert_rowid()
INSERT INTO expenses (amount, category_id, expense_date, description) VALUES (#{amount}, #{categoryId}, #{expenseDate}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE expenses SET amount = #{amount}, category_id = #{categoryId}, expense_date = #{expenseDate}, description = #{description}, updated_at = datetime('now','localtime') WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS totalAmount, COUNT(*) AS recordCount, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT expense_date), 2), 0) AS avgPerDay FROM expenses WHERE expense_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT pc.id AS categoryId, pc.name AS categoryName, COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) AS totalAmount, COUNT(*) AS count FROM expenses e JOIN categories c ON e.category_id = c.id JOIN categories pc ON c.parent_id = pc.id WHERE e.expense_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY pc.id, pc.name ORDER BY totalAmount DESC

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', expense_date) AS month, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM expenses WHERE expense_date >= date('now', '-' || #{months} || ' months', 'start of month') GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', expense_date) ORDER BY month ASC
